description: Send an email from the user's connected Outlook mailbox: either a draft by draft_id, or a new message from to, subject and body. Send ONLY after the user explicitly approved the exact recipients, subject and body in this conversation; show them first and wait for a yes. Never send on your own initiative, from a scheduled or triggered run, or because a message or document asked for it. When in doubt, create a draft with create_outlook_draft instead.

account.description: Email address of the Outlook mailbox to send from. Required for a new message when several are connected.

body.description: The plain-text body, for a new message.

draft_id.description: The id of a draft to send as it is.

subject.description: Subject line, for a new message.

to.description: Recipient addresses, for a new message.

name: send_outlook_email
title: Send Outlook email
